archetypes.name: dyn-ci-log-capture
archetypes.rationale: Full failed-log capture changes newline and exit-code behavior around GitHub Actions diagnostics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the gh run-logs implementation and tests. Focus on whether the full stdout and stderr payload is preserved without regressing in-progress and failure exit codes. Check newline behavior for empty and non-empty command output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
